registered_prior_result.exp11_boundary: Method test only. Not a final PRISM science result.

diagnostic_basis.exp11b: near-miss analysis showed strict failure came from quiet threshold, not burst/contrast

exp11c_best_diagnostic_row.boundary: Diagnostic only. Background-calibrated quiet threshold is post-EXP11 and cannot be claimed as detection.

quiet_gate.threshold: Q25 of valid slide-background max_quiet_rms distribution
quiet_gate.reason: Q25 preserves the idea of preceding quiet relative to background while avoiding an arbitrary fixed RMS=1.0 cutoff.

score.quiet_depth: max(0, qmax - quiet_rms) per detector, then min across detectors
score.candidate_lag_maximization: max over candidates and physical lags for on-source; same max for each slide background

background.unit_of_background: one best score per slide after candidate/lag maximization

sensitivity_rules_secondary_not_for_prim.R1C_loose_diagnostic_only: Q50 or higher background max_quiet_rms, diagnostic only unless separately preregistered before holdout
